claim_1.claim: CyTOF analysis of CD8+ T cells from lymph nodes, bone marrow, spleen, and lungs of three individual donors showed that LN memory CD8+ T cells exhibit a protein expression signature distinct from blood and other tissue sites.

sources.quote: We used cytometry by time-of-flight (CyTOF) to define a protein expression signature of LN memory CD8 + T cells relative to other sites based on the transcriptional profile identified above.

claim_2.claim: T cell receptor repertoire sequencing assay of CD8+ TEM cells from lymph nodes and bone marrow among five individuals showed that LN memory CD8+ T cells maintain higher TCR diversity compared to BM memory CD8+ T cells.

sources.quote: We found an increased number of different V region sequences from comparable numbers of LN compared to BM memory CD8 + T cells for all donors.
